title_en: It's a TRAP! Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark for Web Agents
title_zh: 这是一个陷阱！面向Web智能体的任务重定向说服基准

sentences.en: Web-based agents powered by large language models are increasingly used for tasks such as email management or professional networking.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型驱动的Web智能体日益被用于诸如邮件管理或职业社交等任务。

sentences.en: Their reliance on dynamic web content, however, makes them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks: adversarial instructions hidden in interface elements that persuade the agent to divert from its original task.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对动态Web内容的依赖使其易受提示注入攻击：隐藏在界面元素中的对抗指令会说服智能体偏离其原始任务。

sentences.en: We introduce the Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark (TRAP), a benchmark for studying how persuasion techniques misguide autonomous web agents on realistic tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了任务重定向智能体说服基准（TRAP），一个用于研究说服技术如何在真实任务上误导自主Web智能体的基准。

sentences.en: Across six frontier models, agents are susceptible to prompt injection in 25\% of tasks on average (13\% for GPT-5 to 43\% for DeepSeek-R1), with small interface or contextual changes often doubling success rates and revealing systemic, psychologically driven vulnerabilities in web-based agents.
sentences.zh: 在六个前沿模型上，智能体平均在25\%的任务中易受提示注入（从GPT-5的13\%到DeepSeek-R1的43\%），而细微的界面或上下文改变往往使成功率高出一倍，揭示了Web智能体中系统性、由心理学驱动的漏洞。

sentences.en: We also provide a modular social-engineering injection framework with controlled experiments on high-fidelity website clones, allowing for further benchmark expansion.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供了模块化的社会工程注入框架，在高保真网站克隆上进行受控实验，允许进一步的基准扩展。

title_en: It's TIME: Towards the Next Generation of Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks
title_zh: 是时候了：迈向下一代时间序列预测基准

sentences.en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are revolutionizing the forecasting landscape from specific dataset modeling to generalizable task evaluation.
sentences.zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）正在从特定数据集建模到可泛化任务评估，彻底改变预测格局。

sentences.en: However, we contend that existing benchmarks exhibit common limitations in four dimensions: constrained data composition dominated by reused legacy sources, compromised data integrity lacking rigorous quality assurance, misaligned task formulations detached from real-world contexts, and rigid analysis perspectives that obscure generalizable insights.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们认为现有基准在四个维度上表现出共同的局限：以复用遗留来源为主的数据构成受限、缺乏严格质量保证的数据完整性受损、脱离现实世界背景的任务公式错位，以及掩盖可泛化洞见的僵化分析视角。

sentences.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce **TIME**, a next-generation task-centric benchmark comprising 50 fresh datasets and 98 forecasting tasks, tailored for strict zero-shot TSFM evaluation free from data leakage.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这些差距，我们引入了**TIME**，一个下一代以任务为中心的基准，包含50个全新数据集和98个预测任务，专为严格的、无数据泄漏的零样本TSFM评估而定制。

sentences.en: Integrating large language models and human expertise, we establish a human-in-the-loop benchmark construction pipeline to ensure high data integrity and redefine task formulation by aligning forecasting configurations with real-world operational requirements and variate predictability.
sentences.zh: 集成大语言模型和人类专业知识，我们建立了人在环路的基准构建流水线，以确保高数据完整性，并通过将预测配置与现实世界运行要求和变量可预测性对齐来重新定义任务公式。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a novel pattern-level evaluation perspective that moves beyond traditional dataset-level evaluations based on static meta labels.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一种新颖的pattern级评估视角，它超越了基于静态元标签的传统数据集级评估。

sentences.en: By leveraging structural time series features to characterize intrinsic temporal properties, this approach offers generalizable insights into model capabilities across diverse patterns.
sentences.zh: 通过利用结构化时间序列特征刻画内在时间属性，该方法为跨多样pattern的模型能力提供了可泛化洞见。

sentences.en: We evaluate 12 TSFMs and establish a multi-granular leaderboard to facilitate in-depth analysis and visualized inspection.
sentences.zh: 我们评估了12个TSFM，并建立了一个多粒度排行榜，以促进深入分析和可视化检查。

sentences.en: The leaderboard is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Real-TSF/TIME-leaderboard.
sentences.zh: 排行榜可在 https://huggingface.co/spaces/Real-TSF/TIME-leaderboard 获取。

title_en: Item Response Scaling Laws: A Measurement Theory Approach for Efficient and Generalizable Neural Scaling Estimation
title_zh: 题目响应缩放定律：高效且可泛化神经缩放估计的测量理论方法

sentences.en: Scaling laws provide a fundamental framework for understanding the performance of Language Models (LMs), yet deriving them requires prohibitively expensive evaluations across thousands of checkpoints or millions of inference samples.
sentences.zh: 缩放定律为理解语言模型（LMs）的性能提供了基本框架，然而推导它们需要跨数千个检查点或数百万个推断样本的令人望而却步的昂贵评估。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Item Response Scaling Laws (IRSL), a unified framework that integrates Item Response Theory (IRT) within the scaling law framework.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了题目响应缩放定律（IRSL），一个将项目反应理论（IRT）集成到缩放定律框架中的统一框架。

sentences.en: Unlike traditional approaches that treat each model-benchmark pair in isolation, IRSL disentangles latent model ability from question characteristics, factorizing the scaling law estimation for $M$ models and $N$ questions to significantly reduce parameter complexity from $O(M \times N)$ to $O(M + N)$.
sentences.zh: 与将每个模型-基准对孤立处理的传统方法不同，IRSL将潜在模型能力与问题特征解耦，将 $M$ 个模型和 $N$ 个问题的缩放定律估计因式分解，从而将参数复杂度从 $O(M \times N)$ 显著降低到 $O(M + N)$。

sentences.en: We instantiate IRSL with Beta-IRT, which leverages the empirical probability responses of LMs---such as token probabilities in pre-training and pass rates in test-time sampling---to capture richer signals than binary responses.
sentences.zh: 我们用Beta-IRT实例化IRSL，它利用LM的经验概率响应——如预训练中的词元概率和测试时采样中的通过率——以捕获比二值响应更丰富的信号。

sentences.en: We validate our approach across two prevalent scaling paradigms: (1) pre-training downstream scaling, using 6,612 LM checkpoints and 37,682 questions from 10 benchmarks; and (2) test-time scaling, using 12 LMs and 120 questions from 4 benchmarks with up to 2,500 samples per question.
sentences.zh: 我们在两种流行的缩放范式中验证了我们的方法：（1）预训练下游缩放，使用来自10个基准的6,612个LM检查点和37,682个问题；以及（2）测试时缩放，使用来自4个基准的12个LM和120个问题，每个问题最多2,500个样本。

sentences.en: Given a one-time calibration on existing model responses, IRSL yields more reliable scaling estimates using only 50 questions per benchmark (a 99.9\% reduction), achieving comparable or superior decision accuracy to traditional approaches.
sentences.zh: 在对现有模型响应进行一次校准后，IRSL仅使用每基准50个问题（减少99.9\%）就能产生更可靠的缩放估计，实现与传统方法相当或更优的决策准确率。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that the estimated latent model abilities are generalizable, enabling accurate performance forecasting across benchmarks that share the same measurement objective.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，估计的潜在模型能力是可泛化的，从而能够跨共享相同测量目标的基准进行准确的性能预测。

title_en: Iterated Population Based Training with Task-Agnostic Restarts
title_zh: 带任务无关重启的迭代式基于种群的训练

sentences.en: Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) can lift the burden of tuning hyperparameters (HPs) of neural networks.
sentences.zh: 超参数优化（HPO）可以减轻调整神经网络超参数（HPs）的负担。

sentences.en: HPO algorithms from the Population Based Training (PBT) family are efficient thanks to dynamically adjusting HPs every few steps of the weight optimization.
sentences.zh: 来自基于种群的训练（PBT）家族的HPO算法是高效的，这得益于它们在权重优化的每几步就动态调整HP。

sentences.en: Recent results indicate that the number of steps between HP updates is an important meta-HP of all PBT variants that can substantially affect their performance.
sentences.zh: 近期结果表明，HP更新之间的步数是所有PBT变体一个重要的元HP，它可能实质影响其性能。

sentences.en: Yet, no method or intuition is available for efficiently setting its value.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前还没有可用的方法或直觉来高效设定其值。

sentences.en: We introduce Iterated Population Based Training (IPBT), a novel PBT variant that automatically adjusts this HP via restarts that reuse weight information in a task-agnostic way and leverage time-varying Bayesian optimization to reinitialize HPs.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了迭代式基于种群的训练（IPBT），一种新颖的PBT变体，它通过重启自动调整这一HP，重启以任务无关的方式重用权重信息，并利用时变Bayesian优化重新初始化HP。

sentences.en: Evaluation on 8 image classification and reinforcement learning tasks shows that, on average, our algorithm matches or outperforms 5 previous PBT variants and other HPO algorithms (random search, ASHA, SMAC3), without requiring a budget increase or any changes to its HPs.
sentences.zh: 在8个图像分类和强化学习任务上的评估表明，平均而言，我们的算法匹敌或超越了5个先前的PBT变体和其他HPO算法（随机搜索、ASHA、SMAC3），而无需增加预算或对其HP做任何改变。

sentences.en: The source code is available online.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在网上获取。

title_en: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
title_zh: 迭代精化神经算子是学得的定点求解器：谱偏差缓解的有原则方法

sentences.en: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias.
sentences.zh: 神经算子充当科学建模的快速、数据驱动替代模型，但通常依赖单片式、单遍推断过程，难以解析高频细节，这一局限被称为谱偏差。

sentences.en: We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了迭代精化神经算子（IRNO），它用一个学得的精化模块增强预训练算子，该模块通过定点迭代迭代式应用。

sentences.en: IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers.
sentences.zh: IRNO将预测分解为粗糙初始化及随后的逐次残差校正，与经典数值求解器相平行。

sentences.en: Under mild assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point.
sentences.zh: 在温和假设下，我们确立了诱导算子的收缩性，确保收敛到唯一不动点。

sentences.en: To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training.
sentences.zh: 为显式针对高频误差，我们提出一种渐进谱损失，它在训练期间随精化步自适应地增加对高频分量的惩罚。

sentences.en: Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05\% improvement on turbulent flow.
sentences.zh: 跨多个物理系统，IRNO持续降低误差，在湍流上实现高达56.05\%的改进。

sentences.en: On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72–36.10\% in low-, 5.07–6.68\% in mid-, and 1.48–2.04\% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count.
sentences.zh: 在活性物质上，谱分析揭示，相对基础算子，归一化误差比在低频降低到27.72–36.10\%、中频5.07–6.68\%、高频1.48–2.04\%，并在超出训练迭代次数后保持稳定。

title_en: Iterative Robust Satisficing: Minimizing Performance Degradation Under Distribution Shift
title_zh: 迭代式鲁棒满足：最小化分布偏移下的性能退化

sentences.en: Modern neural networks often achieve high accuracy on their training distribution but degrade sharply under distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 现代神经网络往往在训练分布上达到高准确率，但在分布偏移下急剧退化。

sentences.en: We address this problem through *Robust Satisficing* (RS), an optimization objective that seeks parameters which attain a target level of in-distribution performance while minimizing *fragility*, defined as the rate at which performance deteriorates as the data distribution departs from training.
sentences.zh: 我们通过*鲁棒满足*（RS）解决这一问题，这是一个优化目标，它寻找达到目标水平分布内性能、同时最小化*脆弱性*（定义为随数据分布偏离训练、性能恶化的速率）的参数。

sentences.en: We develop a gradient-based algorithm, *Iterative Robust Satisficing* (IRS), that directly optimizes this criterion.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一个基于梯度的算法——*迭代式鲁棒满足*（IRS）——它直接优化这一准则。

sentences.en: Across a range of synthetic and real-world distribution shifts, including long-tailed image classification, group shifts induced by spurious correlations, and natural shifts in tabular regression, IRS consistently improves performance on minority and worst-case groups without sacrificing overall accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在一系列合成和现实世界分布偏移中，包括长尾图像分类、由虚假相关诱发的组偏移，以及表格回归中的自然偏移，IRS在不牺牲整体准确率的情况下持续改进少数和最坏情况组的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, IRS achieves these robustness gains with a per-step computational cost similar to standard stochastic gradient descent and requires only a single forward and backward pass per update.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，IRS以与标准随机梯度下降相似的每步计算成本实现这些鲁棒性增益，并且每次更新仅需一次前向和后向传播。

sentences.en: Together, these results suggest that minimizing fragility provides a practical and effective alternative to existing robust training methods for learning models that remain reliable under distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 综合这些结果，它们表明最小化脆弱性为现有鲁棒训练方法提供了一种实用且有效的替代方案，用于学习在分布偏移下仍保持可靠的模型。

title_en: iTryOn: Mastering Interactive Video Virtual Try-On with Spatial-Semantic Guidance
title_zh: iTryOn：通过空间-语义引导掌握交互式视频虚拟试穿

sentences.en: Video Virtual Try-On (VVT) aims to seamlessly replace a garment on a person in a video with a new one.
sentences.zh: 视频虚拟试穿（VVT）旨在将视频中人物身上的服装无缝替换为新服装。

sentences.en: While existing methods have made significant strides in maintaining temporal consistency, they are predominantly confined to non-interactive scenarios where models merely showcase garments.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法在维持时间一致性方面取得了显著进展，但它们主要局限于非交互场景，其中模型仅展示服装。

sentences.en: This limitation overlooks a crucial aspect of real-world apparel presentation: active human-garment interaction.
sentences.zh: 这一局限忽视了现实世界服装展示的一个关键方面：活跃的人-服装交互。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce and formalize a new challenging task: Interactive Video Virtual Try-On (Interactive VVT), where subjects in the video actively engage with their clothing (e.g., pulling a hem or unzipping a jacket).
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们引入并形式化了一个新的挑战性任务：交互式视频虚拟试穿（Interactive VVT），其中视频中的主体积极与其衣物互动（如拉扯衣摆或拉开夹克拉链）。

sentences.en: This task introduces unique challenges beyond simple texture preservation, including: (1) resolving the semantic ambiguity of interactions from standard pose information, and (2) learning complex garment deformations from video where interactive moments are sparse and brief.
sentences.zh: 该任务引入了超越简单纹理保持的独特挑战，包括：（1）从标准姿态信息解析交互的语义歧义，以及（2）在交互时刻稀疏且短暂的情况下学习复杂的服装变形。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose **iTryOn**, a novel framework built upon a large-scale video diffusion Transformer. iTryOn pioneers a multi-level interaction injection mechanism to guide the generation of complex dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了**iTryOn**，一个建立在大规模视频扩散Transformer之上的新颖框架。iTryOn开创了一个多级交互注入机制，以指导复杂动力学的生成。

sentences.en: At the spatial level, we introduce a garment-agnostic 3D hand prior to provide fine-grained guidance for precise hand-garment contact, effectively resolving spatial ambiguity.
sentences.zh: 在空间层面，我们引入一个与服装无关的3D手部先验，以提供手-服装精确接触的细粒度指导，有效解析空间歧义。

sentences.en: At the semantic level, iTryOn leverages global captions for overall context and time-stamped action captions for localized interactions, synchronized via our novel Action-aware Rotational Position Embedding (A-RoPE).
sentences.zh: 在语义层面，iTryOn利用全局字幕提供整体上下文，利用带时间戳的动作字幕提供局部化交互，并通过我们新颖的动作感知旋转位置嵌入（A-RoPE）进行同步。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we design an action-aware constraint loss to stabilize training and focus the learning process on these critical interactive frames.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计了一个动作感知约束损失以稳定训练，并将学习过程聚焦于这些关键交互帧。

sentences.en: To facilitate research and evaluation, we construct VVT-Interact, the first large-scale dataset for this task, and propose a novel interaction-aware evaluation metric to quantify the semantic fidelity of interactions.
sentences.zh: 为促进研究和评估，我们构建了VVT-Interact，该任务的首个大规模数据集，并提出一种新颖的交互感知评估指标以量化交互的语义保真度。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that iTryOn not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on traditional VVT benchmarks but also establishes a commanding lead in the new interactive setting, marking a significant step towards more dynamic and controllable virtual try-on experiences.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，iTryOn不仅在传统VVT基准上取得了最先进的性能，还在新的交互设置中建立了主导性的领先优势，标志着迈向更动态、更可控的虚拟试穿体验的重要一步。

title_en: ITSPACE: Monotone Gaussian Optimal Transport Updates
title_zh: ITSPACE：单调高斯最优传输更新

sentences.en: Covariance matrices serve as compact descriptors of feature distributions in many machine-learning pipelines, including domain adaptation and Gaussian embeddings.
sentences.zh: 协方差矩阵在许多机器学习流水线中充当特征分布的紧凑描述符，包括域适配和高斯嵌入。

sentences.en: Under a centered Gaussian approximation, the *unregularized* Wasserstein-2 *optimal transport* (OT) discrepancy admits a closed form on covariances given by the *Bures--Wasserstein* (BW) objective on the *symmetric positive definite* (SPD) cone.
sentences.zh: 在中心高斯近似下，*无正则化的*Wasserstein-2*最优传输*（OT）差异在协方差上允许一个闭式形式，由*对称正定*（SPD）锥上的*Bures--Wasserstein*（BW）目标给出。

sentences.en: We propose **ITSPACE** (Iterative Transport for Stable Proximal Alignment of Covariance Embeddings), a proximal majorization-minimization method that directly optimizes this exact BW objective through closed-form updates in a square-root factorization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**ITSPACE**（协方差嵌入稳定近端对齐的迭代传输），一种近端极大极小化方法，它通过平方根因式分解中的闭式更新直接优化这一精确的BW目标。

sentences.en: In exact arithmetic, each iteration satisfies a sufficient-decrease inequality for the BW objective; under inexact polar computations, we provide an explicit certificate-gap bound controlling deviations from exact descent.
sentences.zh: 在精确算术下，每次迭代满足BW目标的充分下降不等式；在非精确极坐标计算下，我们提供一个显式证书间隙界，控制对精确下降的偏差。

sentences.en: The resulting iterations preserve PSD structure by construction and naturally support rank-restricted factors, making **ITSPACE** well-suited as a lightweight inner-loop primitive in settings where adaptation must be performed from unlabeled target batches under strict step and compute budgets.
sentences.zh: 所得迭代通过构造保持PSD结构，并自然支持秩受限因子，使**ITSPACE**在必须在严格步长和计算预算下从未标记目标批次执行适配的设置中，非常适合作为轻量级内环原语。

sentences.en: Across real-world covariance-alignment benchmarks, **ITSPACE** reaches low-BW-gap solutions substantially faster than BW-gradient descent, methods based on other covariance geometries, and entropically regularized sample-OT baselines.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界协方差对齐基准上，**ITSPACE**达到低BW间隙解的速度大幅快于BW梯度下降、基于其他协方差几何的方法以及熵正则化样本OT基线。

title_en: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: iVGR：用强化学习将视觉依托推理内化到MLLM中

sentences.en: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然视觉依托的思维链（CoT）已涌现为增强多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）细粒度感知的一种有前景的范式，但其在推断阶段的效能仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们从经验上发现，在推断期间强制要求视觉依托CoT中包含显式物体框，往往相比不进行显式视觉依托推理的标准文本CoT会降低性能。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that the visual localization capability can be internalized into the textual CoT and that the mandatory explicit grounding introduces unnecessary interference with the model's primary objective of answer prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们假设，视觉定位能力可以内化到文本CoT中，而强制性的显式依托会对模型答案预测的主要目标引入不必要的干扰。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we propose Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning (**iVGR**), a novel reinforcement learning framework that transfers localization capabilities into the textual reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了内化视觉依托推理（**iVGR**），一个新颖的强化学习框架，它将定位能力迁移到文本推理过程中。

sentences.en: We employ a dual-stream training strategy, where a textual stream is aligned with a high-quality visually grounded stream via a proposed consistency reward, enabling the model to localize accurately without explicit grounding during inference.
sentences.zh: 我们采用双流训练策略，其中文本流通过一个提出的一致性奖励与高质量视觉依托流对齐，使模型在推断期间无需显式依托即可精确定位。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines on fine-grained benchmarks, while maintaining the flexibility to support tool-assisted inference workflows.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在细粒度基准上显著优于现有基线，同时保持支持工具辅助推断工作流的灵活性。

sentences.en: Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/ivgr/
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://visual-ai.github.io/ivgr/

authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: IVQ: Structured and Lightweight Vector Quantization via Binary Hierarchical Composition Inspired by $\textit{IChing}$
title_zh: IVQ：受 $\textit{IChing}$ 启发的二值层级组合结构化轻量级向量量化

sentences.en: Vector Quantization (VQ) has been widely used in visual and audio representation due to its effectiveness in compressing high-dimensional signals.
sentences.zh: 向量量化（VQ）因其在压缩高维信号方面的有效性而被广泛用于视觉和音频表示。

sentences.en: However, existing VQ methods often rely on large and unstructured codebooks, which leads to inefficient code utilization and frequent codebook collapse.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有VQ方法往往依赖大型且无结构的码本，这导致码利用低效和频繁的码本坍缩。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose *IChing* Vector Quantization (IVQ), a lightweight and structured VQ framework inspired by *IChing*.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了受*IChing*启发的*IChing*向量量化（IVQ），一个轻量级、结构化的VQ框架。

sentences.en: IVQ introduces binary hierarchical composition and geometric symmetry relations into the codebook design, enabling a compact set of structured codes to represent the latent space while maintaining high utilization without codebook collapse.
sentences.zh: IVQ将二值层级组合和几何对称关系引入码本设计，使一组紧凑的结构化码能够在保持高利用率且不坍缩的情况下表示潜在空间。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that IVQ achieves superior quality with significantly smaller codebooks and consistently higher utilization rates compared to several VQ variants in audio representation.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，在音频表示中，相较若干VQ变体，IVQ以显著更小的码本实现了更优的质量和持续更高的利用率。

sentences.en: Auxiliary experiments on visual reconstruction and cross-modal generation further validate the universality and robustness of IVQ.
sentences.zh: 在视觉重建和跨模态生成上的辅助实验进一步验证了IVQ的通用性和鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Codes are released at https://github.com/chouliuzuo/IVQ.
sentences.zh: 代码已在 https://github.com/chouliuzuo/IVQ 发布。

title_en: IVQA-LD: Inclusive Multimodal Understanding for Population with Limb Deficiency
title_zh: IVQA-LD：面向肢体缺陷群体的包容性多模态理解

sentences.en: People with limb differences often face significant challenges in accessing inclusive AI services, largely due to the lack of structured, high-quality resources centered on disability contexts.
sentences.zh: 肢体差异人群在访问包容性AI服务时往往面临重大挑战，这主要是由于缺乏以残障情境为中心的结构化、高质量资源。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a limb-deficiency aware body-centric learning and evaluation paradigm that involves (i) a large-scale limb-aware vision–language dataset and evaluation benchmark for multimodal reasoning, and (ii) a model adaptation strategy for Vision-Language Models (VLM) in limb-difference contexts.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了一个肢体缺陷感知的以身体为中心的学习与评估范式，它包含（i）一个面向多模态推理的大规模肢体感知视觉-语言数据集和评估基准，以及（ii）一个用于肢体差异情境下视觉-语言模型（VLM）的模型适配策略。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first collect limb-difference data covering all eight limb-deficiency types across diverse real-world scenarios.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先收集覆盖所有八种肢体缺陷类型、跨越多样现实场景的肢体差异数据。

sentences.en: The data are systematically organized into 96 limb-affected human action categories and 68 medical-functional classes defined by the World Health Organization (WHO).
sentences.zh: 这些数据被系统地组织为96个肢体受影响的人体动作类别和世界卫生组织（WHO）定义的68个医学功能类别。

sentences.en: Then, we curate an expert-annotated vision–language dataset for limb-aware multimodal understanding, named Inclusive VQA for Limb Deficiency (**IVQA-LD**).
sentences.zh: 随后，我们策划了一个用于肢体感知多模态理解的专家标注视觉-语言数据集，命名为面向肢体缺陷的包容性VQA（**IVQA-LD**）。

sentences.en: IVQA-LD comprises 80K VQA pairs spanning eight core tasks including visual grounding, quantitative reasoning, functional semantic classification, and instructional text generation.
sentences.zh: IVQA-LD包含跨越八个核心任务的80K VQA对，包括视觉定位、定量推理、功能语义分类和指令性文本生成。

sentences.en: We benchmark state-of-the-art VLMs on IVQA-LD and find that they consistently struggle across all tasks, exposing substantial deficiencies in limb-aware perception and reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们在IVQA-LD上对最先进的VLM进行基准测试，发现它们在所有任务上一致地表现挣扎，暴露了肢体感知与推理方面的显著缺陷。

sentences.en: To address this, we further propose a Body-centric Structure-aware Initialization (BSI) strategy that aligns model representations with limb-specific semantics.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们进一步提出了一种以身体为中心的结构感知初始化（BSI）策略，它将模型表示与肢体特定语义对齐。

sentences.en: With BSI, VLMs fine-tuned on IVQA-LD achieve significant performance improvements across all the tasks.
sentences.zh: 借助BSI，在IVQA-LD上微调的VLM在所有任务上都取得了显著的性能提升。

sentences.en: We will publicly release the dataset to support future research.
sentences.zh: 我们将公开发布数据集以支持未来研究。

title_en: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
title_zh: iWorld-Bench：带统一动作生成框架的交互式世界模型基准

sentences.en: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action.
sentences.zh: 实现通用人工智能（AGI）需要能够自适应学习和交互的智能体，而交互式世界模型为感知、推理和动作提供了可扩展的环境。

sentences.en: Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前研究仍缺乏大规模数据集和统一基准来评估它们的物理交互能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception and memory.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了iWorld-Bench，一个用于在距离感知和记忆等交互相关能力上训练和测试世界模型的综合基准。

sentences.en: We construct a diverse dataset with 330k video clips and select 2.1k high-quality samples covering varied perspectives, weather, and scenes.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个包含330k视频片段、并选出2.1k个高质量样本的多样数据集，涵盖不同视角、天气和场景。

sentences.en: As existing world models differ in interaction modalities, we introduce an **Action Generation Framework** to unify evaluation and design six task types, generating 4.9k test samples.
sentences.zh: 由于现有世界模型在交互模态上各不相同，我们引入了一个**动作生成框架**以统一评估并设计出六种任务类型，生成了4.9k个测试样本。

sentences.en: These tasks jointly assess model performance across **visual generation, trajectory following, and memory**.
sentences.zh: 这些任务共同评估模型在**视觉生成、轨迹跟随和记忆**方面的性能。

sentences.en: Evaluating 14 representative world models, we identify key limitations and provide insights for future research.
sentences.zh: 评估14个有代表性的世界模型，我们识别出关键局限，并为未来研究提供了洞见。

sentences.en: The iWorld-Bench model leaderboard is publicly available at iWorld-Bench.com.
sentences.zh: iWorld-Bench模型排行榜已公开发布于 iWorld-Bench.com。

title_en: JADAI: Jointly Amortizing Adaptive Design and Bayesian Inference
title_zh: JADAI：联合分摊自适应设计与Bayesian推断

sentences.en: We consider problems of parameter estimation where design variables can be actively optimized to maximize information gain.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑参数估计问题，其中设计变量可被主动优化以最大化信息增益。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce JADAI, a framework that jointly amortizes Bayesian adaptive design and inference by training a policy, a history network, and an inference network end-to-end.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了JADAI，一个通过端到端训练策略网络、历史网络和推断网络，联合分摊Bayesian自适应设计与推断的框架。

sentences.en: The networks minimize a generic loss that aggregates incremental reductions in posterior error along experimental sequences without density evaluations.
sentences.zh: 这些网络最小化一个通用损失，该损失在没有密度评估的情况下，聚合沿实验序列的后验误差增量缩减。

sentences.en: Inference networks are instantiated with diffusion models that can approximate high-dimensional and multimodal posteriors at every experimental step.
sentences.zh: 推断网络采用扩散模型实例化，它们能够在每个实验步骤近似高维且多峰的后验。

sentences.en: JADAI achieves superior or competitive performance across adaptive design benchmarks.
sentences.zh: JADAI在自适应设计基准上实现了优越或具竞争力的性能。

title_en: JADE: Bridging the Strategic-Operational Gap in Dynamic Agentic RAG
title_zh: JADE：弥合动态智能体RAG中的战略-操作鸿沟

sentences.en: The evolution of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shifted from static retrieval pipelines to dynamic, agentic workflows where a central planner orchestrates multi-turn reasoning.
sentences.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）的演化已从静态检索流水线转向动态、智能体式工作流，其中中央规划器编排多轮推理。

sentences.en: However, existing paradigms face a critical dichotomy: they either jointly optimize modules within rigid, fixed-graph architectures, or enable dynamic planning while treating executors as frozen, black-box tools.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有范式面临一个关键的两难：它们要么在刚性、固定图架构内联合优化模块，要么在将执行器视为冻结的黑盒工具的同时实现动态规划。

sentences.en: We identify that this \textit{decoupled optimization} creates a ``strategic-operational mismatch,'' where sophisticated planning strategies fail to materialize due to unadapted local executors, often causing negative gains despite increased system complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出，这种\textit{解耦优化}造成了“战略-操作失配”，其中复杂的规划策略因不适配的局部执行器而无法实现，往往在增加系统复杂性的同时造成负面收益。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose \textbf{JADE} (\textbf{J}oint \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{E}xecution), a unified framework for joint optimization of planning and execution within dynamic, multi-turn workflows.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了\textbf{JADE}（\textbf{J}oint \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{E}xecution），一个在动态多轮工作流中对规划与执行进行联合优化的统一框架。

sentences.en: By modeling the system as a cooperative multi-agent team with a shared backbone, JADE enables end-to-end learning driven by outcome-based rewards.
sentences.zh: 通过将系统建模为一个共享骨干上的协作多智能体团队，JADE实现了由基于结果的奖励驱动的端到端学习。

sentences.en: This approach facilitates \textit{co-adaptation}: the planner learns to operate within executor capability boundaries, while executors evolve to align with strategic intent.
sentences.zh: 这一方法促进了\textit{协同适应}：规划器学习在执行器能力边界内运作，而执行器则演化为与战略意图对齐。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that JADE transforms disjoint modules into a synergistic system, yielding strong performance improvements via joint optimization and enabling a flexible balance between efficiency and effectiveness through dynamic workflow orchestration.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，JADE将互不关联的模块转变为协同系统，通过联合优化取得强性能改进，并通过动态工作流编排实现效率与有效性之间的灵活平衡。

title_en: JADE: Expert-Grounded Dynamic Evaluation for Open-Ended Professional Tasks
title_zh: JADE：面向开放式专业任务的专家依托动态评估

sentences.en: Evaluating agentic AI on open-ended professional tasks faces a fundamental dilemma between rigor and flexibility.
sentences.zh: 在开放式专业任务上评估智能体AI，面临严谨性与灵活性之间的根本两难。

sentences.en: Static rubrics provide rigorous, reproducible assessment but fail to accommodate diverse valid response strategies, while LLM-as-a-judge approaches adapt to individual responses yet suffer from instability and bias.
sentences.zh: 静态评分指南提供严格、可复现的评估，但无法容纳多样的有效响应策略，而LLM-as-a-judge方法能适应个体响应，却存在不稳定性和偏差。

sentences.en: Human experts address this dilemma by combining domain-grounded principles with dynamic, claim-level assessment.
sentences.zh: 人类专家通过将领域依托的原则与动态、论断级评估相结合来解决这一两难。

sentences.en: Inspired by this process, we propose JADE, a two-layer evaluation framework.
sentences.zh: 受这一过程的启发，我们提出了JADE，一个两层评估框架。

sentences.en: Layer 1 encodes expert knowledge as a predefined set of evaluation skills, providing stable evaluation criteria.
sentences.zh: 第一层将专家知识编码为预定义的评估技能集，提供稳定的评估标准。

sentences.en: Layer 2 performs report-specific, claim-level evaluation to flexibly assess diverse reasoning strategies, with evidence-dependency gating to invalidate conclusions built on refuted claims.
sentences.zh: 第二层执行报告特定、论断级的评估，以灵活评估多样的推理策略，并采用证据依赖门控来否定建立在被反驳论断之上的结论。

sentences.en: Experiments on BizBench show that JADE improves evaluation stability and reveals critical agent failure modes missed by holistic LLM-based evaluators.
sentences.zh: 在BizBench上的实验表明，JADE提高了评估稳定性，并揭示了整体式基于LLM的评估器所遗漏的关键智能体失败模式。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate strong alignment with expert-authored rubrics and effective transfer to HealthBench and DR.BENCH, covering medical and 10-domain professional evaluation settings.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明了与专家创作的评分向导的强对齐，以及向HealthBench和DR.BENCH的有效迁移，覆盖医学和10个领域的专业评估设置。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at https://github.com/smiling-world/JADE.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/smiling-world/JADE 获取。

title_en: JAEGER: Joint 3D Audio-Visual Grounding and Reasoning in Simulated Physical Environments
title_zh: JAEGER：模拟物理环境中的联合3D音视频定位与推理

sentences.en: Current audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are predominantly restricted to 2D perception, relying on RGB video and monaural audio.
sentences.zh: 当前的音视频大语言模型（AV-LLMs）主要局限于2D感知，依赖RGB视频和单声道音频。

sentences.en: This design choice introduces a fundamental dimensionality mismatch that precludes reliable source localization and spatial reasoning in complex 3D environments.
sentences.zh: 这一设计选择引入了根本的维度失配，阻碍了在复杂3D环境中进行可靠的声源定位和空间推理。

sentences.en: We address this limitation by presenting JAEGER, a framework that extends AV-LLMs to 3D space, to enable joint spatial grounding and reasoning through the integration of RGB-D observations and multi-channel first-order ambisonics.
sentences.zh: 我们通过提出JAEGER解决了这一局限，它是一个将AV-LLM扩展到3D空间的框架，通过集成RGB-D观测和多声道一阶环境声，实现联合空间定位与推理。

sentences.en: A core contribution of our work is the neural intensity vector (Neural IV), a learned spatial audio representation that encodes robust directional cues to enhance direction-of-arrival estimation, even in adverse acoustic scenarios with overlapping sources.
sentences.zh: 我们工作的一个核心贡献是神经强度向量（Neural IV），一种学得的空间音频表示，它编码稳健的方向线索以增强到达方向估计，即使在具有重叠声源的不利声学场景中也是如此。

sentences.en: To facilitate large-scale training and systematic evaluation, we propose SpatialSceneQA, a benchmark of 61k instruction-tuning samples curated from simulated physical environments.
sentences.zh: 为促进大规模训练和系统评估，我们提出了SpatialSceneQA，一个从模拟物理环境策划的61k指令调优样本基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses 2D-centric baselines across diverse spatial perception and reasoning tasks, underscoring the necessity of explicit 3D modelling for advancing AI in physical environments.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在多样空间感知和推理任务上持续超越以2D为中心的基线，凸显了显式3D建模对推进物理环境中AI的必要性。

sentences.en: Our source code, pre-trained model checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://github.com/liuzhan22/JAEGER.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码、预训练模型检查点和数据集可在 https://github.com/liuzhan22/JAEGER 获取。

title_en: Jailbreak Foundry: From Papers to Runnable Attacks for Reproducible Benchmarking
title_zh: 越狱铸造厂：从论文到可运行攻击实现可复现基准测试

sentences.en: Jailbreak techniques for large language models (LLMs) evolve faster than benchmarks, making robustness estimates stale and difficult to compare across papers due to drift in datasets, harnesses, and judging protocols.
sentences.zh: 针对大语言模型（LLMs）的越狱技术演进速度快于基准，使得鲁棒性估计过时，并且由于数据集、测试框架和评判协议的漂移，难以跨论文进行比较。

sentences.en: We introduce **JAILBREAK FOUNDRY (JBF)**, a system that addresses this gap via a multi-agent workflow to translate jailbreak papers into executable modules for immediate evaluation within a unified harness.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了**JAILBREAK FOUNDRY（JBF）**，一个通过多智能体工作流将越狱论文转化为可执行模块、以便在统一测试框架内立即评估的系统。

sentences.en: JBF features three core components: (i) *JBF-LIB* for shared contracts and reusable utilities;
sentences.zh: JBF具有三个核心组件：（i）*JBF-LIB*，用于共享契约和可复用工具；

sentences.en: (ii) *JBF-FORGE* for the multi-agent paper-to-module translation; and (iii) *JBF-EVAL* for standardizing evaluations.
sentences.zh: （ii）*JBF-FORGE*，用于多智能体论文到模块翻译；以及（iii）*JBF-EVAL*，用于标准化评估。

sentences.en: Across 30 reproduced attacks, JBF achieves high fidelity with a mean (reproduced$-$reported) attack success rate (ASR) deviation of $+0.26$ percentage points.
sentences.zh: 在30个复现的攻击上，JBF实现了高保真度，其（复现$-$报告）攻击成功率（ASR）偏差均值为 $+0.26$ 个百分点。

sentences.en: By leveraging shared infrastructure, JBF reduces attack-specific implementation code by nearly half relative to original repositories and achieves an 82.5% mean reused-code ratio.
sentences.zh: 通过利用共享基础设施，JBF将攻击特定实现代码相比原始仓库减少了近一半，并实现了82.5%的平均复用代码比。

sentences.en: This system enables a standardized AdvBench evaluation of all 30 attacks across 10 victim models using a consistent GPT-4o judge.
sentences.zh: 该系统使用一致的GPT-4o评判者，实现了全部30个攻击跨10个受害者模型的标准化AdvBench评估。

sentences.en: By automating both attack integration and standardized evaluation, JBF offers a scalable solution for creating living benchmarks that keep pace with the rapidly shifting security landscape.
sentences.zh: 通过自动化攻击集成和标准化评估，JBF为创建能跟上快速演变安全格局的活基准提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title_en: Jailbreak to Protect: Buffering Harmful Fine-Tuning via Temporary Jailbreaking LoRA in Large Language Models
title_zh: 越狱以保护：通过大语言模型中的临时越狱LoRA缓冲有害微调

sentences.en: Fine-tuning-as-a-Service (FaaS) enables personalization of large language models (LLMs) but poses significant safety risks, as fine-tuning user-provided data degrades the model's safety-alignment.
sentences.zh: 微调即服务（FaaS）实现了大语言模型（LLMs）的个性化，但带来显著的安全风险，因为针对用户提供数据的微调会削弱模型的安全对齐。

sentences.en: Prior works addressing this issue typically rely on explicit regularization, which leads to practical limitations.
sentences.zh: 先前解决这一问题的研究通常依赖显式正则化，这带来了实际局限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a different paradigm that neutralizes harmful updates via harmful gradient saturation rather than explicit suppression.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种不同的范式，它通过有害梯度饱和而非显式抑制来中和有害更新。

sentences.en: Our key observation is that, in a jailbroken LLM, safety-degrading gradients are largely saturated, while gradients unrelated to safety remain active during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键观察是，在越狱的LLM中，降低安全的梯度在很大程度上是饱和的，而与安全无关的梯度在微调期间保持活跃。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we introduce a **BufferLoRA-based fine-tuning framework**.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们引入了一个**基于BufferLoRA的微调框架**。

sentences.en: BufferLoRA is a removable adapter that temporarily jailbreaks the model during user fine-tuning, saturating harmful updates while allowing a UserLoRA to learn user-specific tasks.
sentences.zh: BufferLoRA是一个可移除的适配器，它在用户微调期间临时越狱模型，使有害更新饱和，同时允许UserLoRA学习用户特定任务。

sentences.en: After fine-tuning, BufferLoRA is removed to restore the base model’s original safety-alignment.
sentences.zh: 微调之后，移除BufferLoRA以恢复基础模型原有的安全对齐。

sentences.en: To further reinforce safety, we additionally train a SafetyLoRA and integrate its safety components into the UserLoRA via QR decomposition-based merging strategy.
sentences.zh: 为进一步强化安全，我们还训练一个SafetyLoRA，并通过基于QR分解的合并策略将其安全组件集成到UserLoRA中。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves superior performance in both safety and utility, without requiring additional safety data during fine-tuning and with minimal computational cost.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的框架在安全性和实用性两方面均实现了优越的性能，且在微调期间无需额外安全数据、计算成本极低。

title_en: Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models Through the Visual Modality
title_zh: 通过视觉模态越狱视觉-语言模型

sentences.en: The visual modality of vision-language models (VLMs) is an underexplored attack surface for bypassing safety alignment.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的视觉模态是绕过安全对齐的一个未被充分探索的攻击面。

sentences.en: We introduce four jailbreak attacks exploiting the vision component: (1) encoding harmful instructions as visual symbol sequences with a decoding legend, (2) replacing harmful objects with benign substitutes (e.g., bomb $\rightarrow$ banana) then prompting for harmful actions using the substitute term, (3) replacing harmful text in images (e.g., on book covers) with benign words while visual context preserves the original meaning, and (4) visual analogy puzzles whose solution requires inferring a prohibited concept.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了四种利用视觉组件的越狱攻击：（1）将有害指令编码为带解码图例的视觉符号序列；（2）用良性替代物替换有害物体（如炸弹 $\rightarrow$ 香蕉），然后用替代词提示有害动作；（3）将图像中的有害文本（如书籍封面上的）替换为良性词语，同时视觉上下文保持原始含义；以及（4）视觉类比谜题，其解答需要推断一个被禁止的概念。

sentences.en: Evaluating across six frontier VLMs, our visual attacks bypass safety alignment and expose a cross-modality alignment gap: text-based safety training does not automatically generalize to harmful intent conveyed visually.
sentences.zh: 跨六个前沿VLM评估，我们的视觉攻击绕过安全对齐，并暴露了跨模态对齐差距：基于文本的安全训练不会自动泛化到以视觉传达的有害意图。

sentences.en: For example, our visual cipher achieves 40.9\% attack success on Claude-Haiku-4.5 versus 10.7\% for an equivalent textual cipher.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们的视觉密码在Claude-Haiku-4.5上实现了40.9\%的攻击成功率，而等效文本密码为10.7\%。

sentences.en: To further our insight into the attack mechanism, we present preliminary interpretability and mitigation results.
sentences.zh: 为进一步洞悉攻击机制，我们呈现了初步的可解释性和缓解结果。

sentences.en: These findings highlight that robust VLM alignment requires treating vision as a first-class target for safety post-training.
sentences.zh: 这些发现凸显了鲁棒的VLM对齐需要将视觉视为安全后训练的一等目标。

title_en: JANUS-LORA: A Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
title_zh: JANUS-LoRA：用于持续学习的平衡低秩适配

sentences.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for Continual Learning.
sentences.zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）已涌现为持续学习的一种有前景的范式。

sentences.en: It independently updates its low-rank factors ($A$ and $B$), creating a composite update to the full weight matrix through their interaction.
sentences.zh: 它独立更新其低秩因子（$A$ 和 $B$），通过它们的相互作用为完整的权重矩阵创建一个复合更新。

sentences.en: To prevent catastrophic forgetting, this update should remain orthogonal to the task-specific subspace that contains previously learned knowledge.
sentences.zh: 为防止灾难性遗忘，这一更新应保持与包含先前学得知识的特定任务子空间正交。

sentences.en: However, we identify that this composite update systematically violates this orthogonality, reintroducing interference and undermining stability.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们识别出，这一复合更新系统性地违反了这种正交性，重新引入了干扰并削弱了稳定性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, naively enforcing this orthogonality compromises plasticity, disrupting the delicate stability-plasticity trade-off.
sentences.zh: 此外，天真地强制执行这种正交性会损害可塑性，破坏微妙的稳定性-可塑性权衡。

sentences.en: To resolve these issues, we propose Janus-LoRA, a framework that restores this balance through two novel components.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了Janus-LoRA，一个通过两个新组件恢复这种平衡的框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first introduce Gradient Rectification, a closed-form solution that mathematically decouples LoRA's factor updates, enforcing orthogonality against the historical knowledge subspace identified by an efficient Online Estimation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先引入梯度校正，一个以数学方式解耦LoRA因子更新的闭式解，对由高效在线估计识别出的历史知识子空间强制执行正交性。

sentences.en: Next, to enhance plasticity, we introduce a Decoupled Margin Loss that promotes feature-level separation by pushing new feature representations away from old ones, thus creating distinct, low-interference regions for new learning.
sentences.zh: 接下来，为增强可塑性，我们引入一个解耦边缘损失，它通过将新特征表示推离旧表示来促进特征级分离，从而为新学习创建独特、低干扰的区域。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that by harmonizing parameter-level orthogonality with feature-level separation, Janus-LoRA achieves a superior balance and establishes new state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在挑战性基准上的全面实验表明，通过协调参数级正交性与特征级分离，Janus-LoRA实现了优越的平衡并确立了新的最先进性能。

title_en: JanusPipe: Efficient Pipeline Parallel Training for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: JanusPipe：机器学习原子间势能的高效流水线并行训练

sentences.en: Discovering atom-level phenomena requires molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with ab initio accuracy.
sentences.zh: 发现原子级现象需要具有ab initio精度的分子动力学（MD）模拟。

sentences.en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable stable, high-accuracy MD simulations, and their models exhibit scaling-law trends similar to large language models.
sentences.zh: 机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）实现了稳定、高精度的MD模拟，且其模型表现出与大语言模型相似的缩放定律趋势。

sentences.en: However, the lack of scalable and efficient distributed training systems for conservative MLIPs makes them difficult to scale.
sentences.zh: 然而，缺乏面向保守MLIP的可扩展、高效的分布式训练系统，使它们难以扩展。

sentences.en: This is because conservative MLIPs inherently follow a double-backward execution pattern, which involves computing gradients during the forward pass.
sentences.zh: 这是因为保守MLIP固有地遵循双重反向执行模式，其中在前向传播期间即计算梯度。

sentences.en: This pattern creates a mismatch with existing distributed training systems, especially for pipeline parallelism.
sentences.zh: 这种模式与现有的分布式训练系统产生不匹配，尤其是对流水线并行而言。

sentences.en: Therefore, we present JanusPipe, an efficient 3D-parallel (PP/DP/GP) training system tailored for conservative MLIPs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了JanusPipe，一个专为保守MLIP定制的、高效的3D并行（PP/DP/GP）训练系统。

sentences.en: It integrates SymFold to enable memory-efficient pipeline parallelism for conservative MLIPs, and WaveK to reduce pipeline bubbles by balancing the four-phase compute time.
sentences.zh: 它集成了SymFold以实现保守MLIP的内存高效流水线并行，以及WaveK通过平衡四相计算时间来减少流水线气泡。

sentences.en: Experimental results on 32 GPUs show that JanusPipe improves throughput by $1.51\times$ and $1.45\times$ on average over 1F1B and Hanayo, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在32个GPU上的实验结果表明，相较1F1B和Hanayo，JanusPipe平均分别将吞吐量提高了 $1.51\times$ 和 $1.45\times$。

title_en: Joint Enhancement and Classification using Coupled Diffusion Models of Signals and Logits
title_zh: 使用信号与logit的耦合扩散模型进行联合增强与分类

sentences.en: Robust classification in noisy environments remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 在嘈杂环境中的鲁棒分类仍是机器学习中的一个根本挑战。

sentences.en: Standard approaches typically treat signal enhancement and classification as separate, sequential stages: first enhancing the signal and then applying a classifier.
sentences.zh: 标准方法通常将信号增强与分类视为分离的、串行阶段：先增强信号，再应用分类器。

sentences.en: This approach fails to leverage the semantic information in the classifier's output during denoising.
sentences.zh: 这种方法未能利用分类器输出在去噪过程中的语义信息。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a general, domain-agnostic framework that integrates two interacting diffusion models: one operating on the input signal and the other on the classifier's output logits, without requiring any retraining or fine-tuning of the classifier.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个通用的、领域无关的框架，它集成了两个交互式扩散模型：一个作用于输入信号，另一个作用于分类器的输出logit，且无需对分类器进行任何重训练或微调。

sentences.en: This coupled formulation enables mutual guidance, where the enhancing signal refines the class estimation and, conversely, the evolving class logits guide the signal reconstruction towards discriminative regions of the manifold.
sentences.zh: 这种耦合公式实现了相互引导，其中增强信号精化类别估计，反之，演化的类logit将信号重建引导向流形的判别区域。

sentences.en: We introduce three strategies to effectively model the joint distribution of the input and the logit.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了三种策略来有效建模输入与logit的联合分布。

sentences.en: We evaluated our joint enhancement method for image classification and automatic speech recognition.
sentences.zh: 我们评估了我们的联合增强方法用于图像分类和自动语音识别。

sentences.en: The proposed framework surpasses traditional sequential enhancement baselines, delivering robust and flexible improvements in classification accuracy under diverse noise conditions.
sentences.zh: 所提框架超越了传统的串行增强基线，在多样噪声条件下为分类准确率带来了鲁棒且灵活的改进。
